Historical weather forecasts and observed weather near Whychus Creek

Source: R/data.R
all_historical_forecasts.Rd

Combined dataset of archived GFS forecast model output (2019-12-25 onward) and ERA5 reanalysis observed weather (2011-01-01 to 2019-12-24) for the location near Whychus Creek (lat 44.39, lon -121.41). A type column distinguishes the two sources.

Usage

all_historical_forecasts

Format

A data frame with columns:

valid_date

Date. The date the weather value applies to.

issue_date

Date. The model run issue date (NA for historical weather rows).

lead_days

Integer. Forecast lead time in days (NA for historical weather rows).

variable

Character. Variable name: "temperature_2m_max", "temperature_2m_min", or "cloud_cover_mean".

value

Numeric. Variable value in the unit given by units.

units

Character. Units string (e.g. "°C", "%").

lat

Numeric. Latitude (44.390278).

lon

Numeric. Longitude (-121.406792).

type

Character. Data source: "historical forecast" (GFS, 2019-12-25 onward) or "historical weather" (ERA5, 2011-01-01 to 2019-12-24).

Source

Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API (GFS seamless) and Open-Meteo Archive API (ERA5 reanalysis).
